_comment: Ground-truth entity annotations, one row per document. Hand-labelled by reading each source document and listing every asset tag it actually names, in canonical form. This is the reference set for entity precision, recall and F1 -- without it those numbers are unmeasurable, and an unmeasured F1 is exactly the kind of figure this project refuses to print. Labels are conservative: a tag is listed only where the document genuinely names the equipment, and document references (SOP-4412, MOC-2023-07, WO-3502) are deliberately excluded because they are not assets.

doc_title: P&ID CDU-1 Sheet 3 Crude Charge Pumping
notes: The hardest document in the corpus and the one that matters most for this metric. Thirteen tags are lettered on the sheet; a drawing's text layer is fragmentary and the tags are letter-spaced, so recall here is a direct measure of the drawing path. Line numbers (8"-P-1501-A1A and the two others) are excluded: they are lines, not equipment, and are scored separately.
